name: Kelse
description: A mother and outsider from Kessig living in a village; Avacyn once saved her lost son, and Avacyn later kills her in the attack on her village.

timeline.summary: Avacyn returns Maeli to his mother Kelse, and feels satisfied that this is why she exists.
timeline.quote: It took only moments for her to find the mother on the outskirts of the trees and give her the child.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees Kelse turn angry at Maeli and a thought comes to her that mortals are rotten, turning her view of the child from innocence to disgust.
timeline.quote: The seeds of men are rotten.

timeline.summary: Kelse searches for Maeli, who has run off again, and recalls how Avacyn saved him months ago.
timeline.quote: Kelse tried hard not to think of a few months ago, when he had run off.

timeline.summary: Angels appear over Kelse's village and begin killing villagers with spears, swords and fire.
timeline.quote: Then one of the angels pointed her glowing spear downward at the village.

timeline.summary: Kelse orders Maeli to run into the forest and not look back.
timeline.quote: Run! Run now, the fastest you have ever run! To the forest!

timeline.summary: Kelse prays to Avacyn for help and finds that Avacyn herself, dressed in black with blood-red wings, is leading the destruction.
timeline.quote: You do not need to pray your lies to me, creature. I'm right here in front of you.

timeline.summary: Avacyn declares the great work has begun and says she will find Maeli eventually.
timeline.quote: I will find the small creature eventually.

timeline.summary: Avacyn kills Kelse with her spear and watches her ashes blow away.
timeline.quote: Avacyn watched as the remains of the mortal creature blew away, the ashes scattering and swirling for a moment of flight before falling to the ground.

relations.quote: But Avacyn had come, had saved her child, her only child.

relations.note: Avacyn burns her with her spear in the destroyed village.
relations.quote: All will burn. All will bleed.
